critical_code_review_comments: server.py visit_recent_vitals: `limit = max(1, min(limit, 10))` cleanly maps 0 to 1 and caps at 10 — matches contract. Negative limit also becomes 1 (safe).

Query uses `$or` across VITAL_FIELDS with $ne:null — guarantees NOVIT (all-null) rows are skipped; combined with patient_ref $in all_refs and practice_id scoping + physician_user_id filter for physicians, isolation holds.
Projection excludes _id and omits soap entirely — row shape remains compact as spec requires.

VitalsPanel keypad: tabIndex=-1 + onMouseDown preventDefault correctly keeps focus in active input; dot ignored for BP/HR via DECIMAL_OK map; single-dot invariant enforced; blur after final Next clears active state ('Select a field').
last3 header title string format '2026 Oct - 01 · VIS-SAMPLE-HX' satisfies 'contains 2026 Oct - 01' requirement and also surfaces ref_number for hover disambiguation.
